title: cross-member HR builds 2+3, two players: from the HOST's copy of the client's HR plan, a host employee who stays at the host's shop is assigned to the CLIENT's plan (the client accepts the co-member's copy and tags the host's real record through the host); the client's daily training then routes ONE leg for that person to the host, applied once; a same-day repeat is dropped; the unassign clears the tag on the host; a re-assign then the plan's DELETE clears it again; then the OWN-PLAN path (fold 3b): the host puts a CLIENT's person on its OWN HR plan through the pane's own code path (the `planown` lever) and the tag lands on the client's real record, and the untick clears it; ends dissolved, NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1: Client1's HR plan oMg0Ie6U0iAKs859EUeIg== on 52 ba:street_fifthavenue has an HR manager and trainingTarget 100 (read from the 2026-09-12 00:15 mirror). It already lists SIX of the host's people from 15 ba:street_thirdavenue, where EVERY one of the 33 staff is at primary skill 100 (run 1 of this scenario, 07:21) - native's training moves nothing for them - so the capture below picks a host person at 6 ba:street_seventhstreet (32 of its 36 people are below 98 in the 00:15 host mirror). (The client's save also carries those six as copies embedded in stale open salary negotiations, the M4 leak of F-2026-09-12-AC, closed for new saves in 033e705; harmless to this run.) Build CROSS-HR-3 deployed (the `planedit ... true|false` parser fix, `hrtag`, `hrplanof`). FIXTURE HYGIENE: assignments, tags, skills and wages change in memory only; the client's plan is DELETED in memory at the end; NOTHING is saved.
oracles_absent: not a co-member of the same company
owner is offline and nobody stands in
stands in for the owner and holds the record itself

steps.note: both worlds settle: the host's staff copies land on the client, the client's HR plan lands on the host as a display row
a HOST person at the host's shop, id without + or / (kept simple), primary skill below 98 so the plan's training (target 100) moves it (the skill name itself carries a colon: ba:skill_x:NN)

expect_log.regex: \[CrossHR\] hr assign on plan '${plan}': employee '${hostEmp}' is a co-member's person here - on the list, tag write sent to its owner\.
\[CrossHR\] applied routed hrtag on employee '${hostEmp}': plan '[^']*' -> '${plan}' \(from '${clientPid}'\)\.

steps.note: A2: the client (the plan's runner) accepts the co-member's injected copy, lists it, and routes the tag write to the host, which writes it on the REAL record

steps.expect_result: ^OK hrplanof employee='${hostEmp}' record=real owner='[^']*' plan='${plan}' resolves=shadow
steps.note: the host's real record carries the client's plan id, which resolves here as a SHADOW
the client's plan feed (MarkUrgent, 2 s) refreshes the host's display row
the HOST's display copy of the client's real plan now lists the host's person (planlist reads PARTNER rows - run 2 slip: it cannot read the runner's own plan)

steps.expect_result: ^OK hrtrain plan='${plan}' assigned=[1-9]\d* manager=True injected=[1-9]\d* legs=[1-9]\d*

expect_log.regex: \[CrossHR\] applied routed training to '${hostEmp}' \([1-9]\d* skill\(s\), wage [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+; the copy moved x[\d.]+\) for partner plan '${plan}'

steps.note: CROSS-HR-2: the runner's daily pass sends ONE leg for the host's person; the host applies it to the real record once

steps.expect_result: ^OK hrtrain plan='${plan}' assigned=[1-9]\d* manager=True injected=[1-9]\d* legs=[1-9]\d*
steps.note: the same day's leg for the same person is a no-op on the owner (the stamp)

expect_log.regex: \[CrossHR\] hr tag CLEAR leg for employee '${hostEmp}' \(plan '${plan}', left this HR plan\) -> owner '${hostPid}'
\[CrossHR\] cleared routed hrtag on employee '${hostEmp}': plan '${plan}' -> '-' \(from '${clientPid}'\)\.

steps.note: A2: the unassign drops the id from the client's real plan and routes a tag CLEAR to the host

steps.expect_result: ^OK hrplanof employee='${hostEmp}' record=real owner='[^']*' plan='-?' resolves=(none|-)
steps.note: the tag is gone on the host

expect_log.regex: \[CrossHR\] applied routed hrtag on employee '${hostEmp}': plan '[^']*' -> '${plan}' \(from '${clientPid}'\)\.
\[CrossHR\] hr plan '${plan}' \(the plan was deleted\): [1-9]\d* co-member tag clear\(s\) sent before the plan goes\.
\[CrossHR\] cleared routed hrtag on employee '${hostEmp}': plan '${plan}' -> '-' \(from '${clientPid}'\)\.

steps.note: A3: deleting the client's plan clears the tag on EVERY member's record - the host's included (in memory only; no save)

steps.expect_result: ^OK hrplanof employee='${hostEmp}' record=real owner='[^']*' plan='-?' resolves=(none|-)

steps.note: fold 3b B6: a CLIENT person at the client's shop (injected on the host)

steps.expect_result: ^OK planown hr ${hostPlan} assign ${clientEmp} True listed=[1-9]\d* coMember=True

expect_log.regex: \[CrossHR\] hr tag SET leg for employee '${clientEmp}' \(plan '${hostPlan}', joined this HR plan\) -> owner '${clientPid}'
\[CrossHR\] applied routed hrtag on employee '${clientEmp}': plan '[^']*' -> '${hostPlan}' \(from '${hostPid}'\)\.

steps.note: B1: the pane's own path on MY OWN plan (native list + copy tag, then the postfix's helper) sends the tag to the client's real record

^OK planown hr ${hostPlan} assign ${clientEmp} False listed=\d+ coMember=True

\[CrossHR\] cleared routed hrtag on employee '${clientEmp}': plan '${hostPlan}' -> '-' \(from '${hostPid}'\)\.

steps.note: B1: the untick on my own plan clears the tag on the client's real record
